hypotheses.P1_weight_canonicalization_is_exact: Rotating each frozen family output subspace into its tensor-Frobenius eigendirections preserves the subspace projector and restricted tensor energy within 1e-5 relative error.
hypotheses.P2_conditioned_axes_are_coordination_out: For at least three of five families, the median leading eigenvalue across four canonical axes exceeds every matched sign-coordination null.
hypotheses.P3_conditioning_enriches_low_rank_forms: For at least three of five families, median top-four interaction energy exceeds the 95th percentile across random output directions.
hypotheses.P4_conditioned_powerlaw_spikes_are_commo: For at least three of five families, at least one canonical axis has positive leading log excess above its fitted rank-33--512 power law.
hypotheses.P5_every_family_has_an_exceptional_axis: Every known semantic family has at least one canonical axis whose leading eigenvalue exceeds every matched sign-coordination null.
hypotheses.P6_family_conditioning_beats_global_conc: Every family has median canonical-axis top-four energy above the full Layer-3 tensor-map top-four energy.
